text:
If I have lost life, time, everything

I threw, like a ring, into the water,

if I have lost my voice in the thicket,

the word remains to me.


If I have suffered thirst, hunger, everything

that was mine and turned out to be nothing,

if I have reaped the shadows in silence,

the word remains to me.


If I opened my lips to see the pure

and terrible face of my homeland,

if I opened my lips until I tore them,

the word remains to me.

translation.title: In the Beginning
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the repeated claim that after every loss, the word remains.
